author: c. m. ralston
title: Biberdorf and Wallace receive Summit League academic honors for swimming and diving
text:
Eastern Illinois University announced on Mar. 25 that two of its student-athletes, Genevieve Biberdorf and Nolan Wallace, have been named to the Summit League Swimming & Diving Academic All-League teams. Both athletes were recognized for their academic achievements as well as their performances in the pool.
The Academic All-League team requires student-athletes to maintain a cumulative grade point average of at least 3.30 on a 4.0 scale, complete at least one full academic year at their current institution, and participate in at least half of their team’s competitions.
Genevieve Biberdorf, a senior from Woodway, Texas majoring in biochemistry with a perfect 4.00 GPA, earned her second career academic all-league honor. Last season she was also named All-District by College Sports Communicators. In competition this past season, Biberdorf participated in individual medley and breaststroke events at the Summit League Championship where she achieved three personal best times and two top ten finishes. She set a new school record in the 100-yard breaststroke with a time of 1:04.22 and holds the second fastest time in school history for the 200-yard breaststroke.
Nolan Wallace, a junior from Waunakee, Wisconsin majoring in construction management with a GPA of 3.93, also received his second career academic all-league recognition. He was previously named Academic All-District by College Sports Communicators last season as well. Wallace competes primarily in breaststroke events and is part of Eastern Illinois’ record-holding team for the 200 medley relay with a combined time of 1:29.17.
Both Biberdorf’s and Wallace’s recognitions highlight Eastern Illinois University’s commitment to both athletic performance and academic excellence among its student-athletes.
